sourceText:
Cilantro Rice With Mixed Vegetables
By: Amritha Kalyani
Published: Tuesday, October 12, 2010 - 9:09pm

Ingredients




1 cup Mixed Vegetables-
1 teaspoon Cumin powder-
1 teaspoon Corriander powder-
1/2 Onion- chopped
1 tablespoon Oil-
1 cup Basmati Rice-
To Grind:
1 bunch Cilantro
2 Cloves-
1 Cardomom-
1 Tomato-
1 teaspoon Ginder- chopped
3 pods Garlic-
1 teaspoon Cumin powder-
1 teaspoon Corriander powder-
2 Green Chilli-

Preparation

1 Grind all the above said ingredients to grind. Grind it to a smooth paste. Need not add water. The water in tomato and cilantro is good enough. 2 Soak basmati rice in water for about 15 mins 3 In a pan, heat oil and add onions. Fry till it becomes translucent. Now add this groung paste and fry till the fresh green color changes to dark green. The color will change and the raw smell will fade. 4 Now add vegetables and mix well. Fry it for another minute 5 Now add rice, salt and mix everything well. 6 Add 2 cups water and transfer it to rice cooker. 7 Aromatic cilantro rice will fill your house with rich aroma and flavor.
